svg.title: Laser-driven bubble model implementations and proposed extensions
svg.desc: Three separate implemented source-model variants, with diagnostic-only optical fractions distinguished from feedback and proposed physical extensions shown with dashed outlines.
svg.text: 1064 nm irradiation of Fe₃O₄ beads in liquid
Observed dark-region growth, contraction and episodic optical emission
Figure 3 optics: τ = τ₀(1 + 4M_np), T_diag = exp(−τ), A_diag = 1 − T_diag
These absorption-only fractions are diagnostics and do not enter the energy update.
B Two-reservoir ensemble with logistic activation (Figure 5)
T_e is a modeled reservoir temperature. T_i evolves internally. The source does not calculate a spectrum.
C Extended ensemble with Saha and loading feedback (Figure 6)
Figures 3 and 6 include pressure-impulse or threshold damage indicators, without resolved membrane mechanics.
Further physics and validation beyond these implementations
* Figures 5–6: radial pressure and event-energy updates require correction and convergence tests.
Implemented components describe code structure and do not establish physical validation.
